notes.title: The Wishing Well, best of game design!
notes.notes:
🏆 Big Success, Everyone! 🏆

We are thrilled to announce that [b]The Wishing Well[/b] has just won the [b]Best of Game Design[/b] award at [b]Thailand's Game Talent Showcase 3[/b]! 🥳

[url=https://www.facebook.com/share/sNoWRjLGiGGUW1H4/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046674/3740cf53e5f907ad7e79852547246d9212209bb3.jpg[/img][/url]

Though we [i]missed[/i] the [b]Audience's Choice[/b] award, we're incredibly grateful to everyone who supported us!

▶ To celebrate, we're excited to announce that [b]the first official DEMO build[/b] will be released on Steam [u][b]this August[/b][/u]!

Thank you all for your kind support. We look forward to providing you with the best experience. Stay tuned, and we'll see you in the next one!

The Wishing Well Team

notes.title: [Ended] The Wishing Well and the Audiences Choice Award?
notes.notes:
👋 Hi, fellas!

Welcome to the first big announcement for our game: [b]The Wishing Well[/b] is participating in the [b]Thailand Game Talent Showcase 2024[/b]. This is an important step in the development of the game. And guess what? We have a chance to win the [b]Audiences Choice Award[/b]! 🏆

[url=https://www.facebook.com/share/4axf8N3Zf7rWsyu3/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046674/4d2ade028528f1029b6f17ebaff9c8cfc6d8e0cb.jpg[/img][/url]

As the name suggests, the award goes to the game with [b]the most engagement[/b]. If you believe in us and want to show your love, please head to this [url=https://www.facebook.com/share/4axf8N3Zf7rWsyu3/]link [i](Facebook)[/i][/url] and react to the post!

[i][u]Update[/u]: This event has ended. Too bad, but next time we won't miss it![/i]

Your support means the world to us! We appreciate all kinds of support from you. Thank you so much!

▶ We're looking forward to providing you with [b]more game updates[/b] as soon as possible. Please stay tuned!

Thank you again,
The Wishing Well Team
